digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Monday, August 31, with eight timed calendar blocks, three urgent priorities, five relevant carry-overs, and no active reminders. The day turns on Amazon Connect UAT recovery, the 2:30 PM Quality portfolio prioritization, and closing the remaining migration-list gaps before the compressed 2:00-5:00 PM meeting run. UAT reached 20.1%, but Monday completion is unlikely; number provisioning and spoofing ownership remain the leading go-live risk. Dashboard state was last modified Friday, so completion status may not reflect any weekend changes.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect UAT recovery decision
items.detail: Recorded completion rose to 20.1%, but the team does not expect to finish by EOD Monday. Use the 4:00 PM working session to validate routing and time-zone fixes, confirm the number-provisioning and spoofing owner, and decide whether testing continues through Wednesday, September 2.

items.label: Prioritize Licelot's Quality project portfolio
items.detail: Bring the five named requests into the 2:30 PM review, rank them by business impact, and set one intake path plus realistic PM and PE capacity before assigning work.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect migration-list gaps
items.detail: Friday follow-up reduced the workbook from 119 to 36 open lines. Confirm the remaining leaders, preserve the N/A plus Reporting guidance for non-calling users, and lock the production provisioning list.

items.label: limpiar asana con spreadsheet de Armando
items.detail: Use the noon blocked space to reconcile Armando's spreadsheet against Asana, close stale entries, and leave one current operating view before the afternoon portfolio meetings.

items.label: Decide Eduanny Suero's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and appropriate permission for the Travel Permit client-contact SOP, then approve or decline the outstanding SharePoint request.

items.label: 8:00-9:00 AM - Timecards and weekly setup
items.detail: Approve timecards and convert the Amazon, Quality, and portfolio risks into a short decision list for the day.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - SVC Daily Standup
items.detail: Confirm the latest UAT fixes and press for a named owner and Monday update on number provisioning and spoofing documentation.

items.label: 12:00-1:00 PM - Protected work block
items.detail: Use the clean focus window for the migration list, Asana reconciliation, and Quality portfolio preparation before the afternoon stack.

items.label: 2:00-3:00 PM - BD portfolio and Quality project decisions
items.detail: Move directly from BD priorities into the Quality review with duplicate intake concerns, business impact, and delivery capacity already organized.

items.label: 3:00-4:00 PM - Maria and Astrid 1:1s
items.detail: Use the back-to-back conversations to settle portfolio roadblocks, owners, and any dependencies that need escalation this week.

items.label: 4:00-5:00 PM - Amazon Connect UAT working session
items.detail: Treat this as the day's technical decision point: capture validated results, unresolved defects, go-live risks, and the recommendation on extending UAT through Wednesday.

items.label: Clear the stalled Sales and Revenue Cloud dependencies
items.detail: This morning's Teams activity shows Revenue Cloud still waiting on an owner and Sales Cloud needing Deepak and Tim engaged, an invoice record in sandbox, and firm due dates. Use the BD review to confirm ownership, escalation, and the next checkpoint.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Jhara 1:1, SVC, and mandatory self-review training
items.detail: The 11:00 AM English self-review session follows the SVC standup; choose this required session or plan one of the alternate dates.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - EPMO and Nicolas meetings
items.detail: Bring Monday's portfolio decisions into the EPMO leadership cadence and Nicolas 1:1 so risks, dependencies, and owners stay aligned.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Amazon UAT final session conflicts with CSC portfolio review
items.detail: Decide coverage in advance. The UAT session is framed as the final defect-submission window, while the CSC portfolio review begins at the same time.
